response.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS m FROM pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.avg_cnt, p.avg_cnt - o.m AS diff FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.m), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_cnt) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(diff) AS avg_above_overall_mean FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind AS trader_type, avg_analyst_count, avg_above_overall_mean, avg_analyst_count / AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER () AS relative_ratio FROM per_type
